description: Title/escrow company's wiring instructions for closing funds. Never modeled in LG-discOrch, LG-docsOrch, or lg-RMOrch prior to this (architecture doc item J-T11) — new schema, relevant for wire-fraud prevention.
verification_description: Wire beneficiary name - if not found, this is not a wire instructions document

beneficiary_name.description: Beneficiary name on the wire instructions (REQUIRED for verification). Should match the title/settlement agent named on the title commitment — this is the core wire-fraud check (RM Job Aid p.17, J-T11).

account_number_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the account number (do not extract the full account number)

issued_date.description: Date the wire instructions were issued
